context: Daichi preps a Setsubun event at his shop.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: festival prep; vocabulary (鬼/新しく/とら/おっしゃる/パー) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 節分やから、鬼の役、やるんよ。
lines.en: It's Setsubun, so I'll play the demon.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty playful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 豆は、新しく仕入れたんですか?
lines.en: Did you newly stock the beans?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そや、新しく箱で買うたで。
lines.en: Yeah, I bought a new box.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 豆まきは、パーッと撒くんですか?
lines.en: Do you scatter the beans with a flourish?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: パーッと撒いて、鬼を追い出すんや。
lines.en: Scatter them with gusto and drive out the demon.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm playful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お客さんは、何ておっしゃってました?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 「楽しみや」と、おっしゃってたで。
lines.en: They said they're looking forward to it.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: まだ準備、終わっとらんけどな!
lines.en: Though I haven't finished prepping yet!
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
